info.title: LuxAlgo public API
info.description: The public, unauthenticated surface of the LuxAlgo app API: payment plans, prop-firm data (including a filterable query surface for firms, challenges, and offers), the indicator library, and marketing state. Every response is wrapped in a { data, errors } envelope — data on success, errors[] on failure. The full indicator library is also available as an MCP server at https://mcp.luxalgo.com/mcp, and site content as markdown via https://www.luxalgo.com/llms.txt.

get.summary: Public: search visible prop firms. Combine firm, challenge, and offer filters; omit filters to list all. Nested challenge/offer filters match a firm when at least one child matches. Use include=challenges,offers,overview to nest matching children.

schema.description: Case-insensitive search over firm name and public slug.
Comma-separated product types (CFD, Futures). Firm must offer at least one.
Comma-separated markets (forex, indices, …). Firm must offer at least one.
Comma-separated platforms (MT5, TradingView, …). Firm must offer at least one.
Comma-separated payment methods. Firm must offer at least one.
Comma-separated payout methods. Firm must offer at least one.
Comma-separated country names. Firm must not list any of them as restricted (e.g. United States).
When true, firm must currently have a live (active, unexpired) offer.
Case-insensitive substring of the challenge name.
Exact evaluation step count (1 = instant / funded, 2 = two-step, …).
Minimum evaluation step count (ignored when steps is set).
Maximum evaluation step count (ignored when steps is set).
Maximum required minimum trading days (less-strict challenges).
Maximum daily-loss limit magnitude (smaller number = stricter; this is an upper bound).
Comma-separated drawdown modes: static-initial, trailing-realized-eod, trailing-intraday-unrealized. Challenges without a captured mode never match.
Comma-separated challenge fee intervals (e.g. one-time, monthly).
Case-insensitive substring of the promo code.
Case-insensitive search over promo code and offer descriptions.
Defaults to live offers only. Pass false to look at inactive offers.
Minimum discount value (percent or absolute, matching discountIsPercent).
When true, inactive offers are not hidden. Defaults to false.
When true, ended offers are not hidden. Defaults to false.
Page size. Defaults to 50, capped at 100.
Sort direction. Defaults per sort key.
Comma-separated extra payloads: challenges, offers, overview.

200.description: Success. The payload is wrapped in the standard { data, errors } envelope.

400.description: Validation error — errors[].details carries the zod issues.

get.summary: Public: search challenges across visible firms. Filter by challenge rules and parent firm; pass propfirmId to list one firm's challenges. Use include=offers to attach live offers that apply to each challenge.

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring of the challenge name.
Exact evaluation step count (1 = instant / funded, 2 = two-step, …).
Minimum evaluation step count (ignored when steps is set).
Maximum evaluation step count (ignored when steps is set).
Maximum required minimum trading days (less-strict challenges).
Maximum daily-loss limit magnitude (smaller number = stricter; this is an upper bound).
Comma-separated drawdown modes: static-initial, trailing-realized-eod, trailing-intraday-unrealized. Challenges without a captured mode never match.
Comma-separated challenge fee intervals (e.g. one-time, monthly).
Page size. Defaults to 50, capped at 100.
Sort direction. Defaults per sort key.
Case-insensitive search over challenge name and firm name/slug.
Comma-separated product types the parent firm must offer.
Comma-separated markets the parent firm must offer.
Comma-separated platforms the parent firm must offer.
Comma-separated country names the parent firm must not restrict.

200.description: Success. The payload is wrapped in the standard { data, errors } envelope.

400.description: Validation error — errors[].details carries the zod issues.

get.summary: Public: search promotional offers across visible firms. Defaults to live (active, unexpired) offers. Pass propfirmId for one firm's offers, or challengeId for offers that apply to a challenge (firm-wide offers included).

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring of the promo code.
Case-insensitive search over promo code and offer descriptions.
Defaults to live offers only. Pass false to look at inactive offers.
Minimum discount value (percent or absolute, matching discountIsPercent).
When true, inactive offers are not hidden. Defaults to false.
When true, ended offers are not hidden. Defaults to false.
Page size. Defaults to 50, capped at 100.
Sort direction. Defaults per sort key.
Case-insensitive search over promo code, descriptions, and firm name/slug.
Comma-separated challenge ids. An offer matches when it applies to at least one (all-challenges offers match that firm's challenges).
Defaults to featured first, then discount.
